newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said the extensive role of the puiblic sector would have to be minimised gradually with an ultimate objective to generate efficiency and skill.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is to leave for New Delhi on Monday on a four-day official visit to sign a water sharing accord between Bangladesh and India. Bangladesh may get 34,500 cusecs of Ganges water under the proposed accord.

Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria urged all concerned not to create panic in the share market. He said the government wanted the share market to stabilise through market operation but not through interference.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has asked the Bangladesh Bar Council to suggest names for appointing women judges.
A Chinese engineer was shot dead by armed miscreants at Bashbaria of Sitakunda police station area of Chittagong on Wednesday.
Commerce and Industries Minister Tofael Ahmed called upon the Chinese entrepreneurs to set up joint venture cement factories in Bangladesh to cater to a huge demand of the building material.
The chief of the visiting Chinese delegation said they had already identified a few sectors in Bangladesh to invest, including setting up of cottege industries.
